Moves from the label to the remove button (two tab stops)
keyboard.when: the token is clickable or a link, and removable

differences.text: `clickable` and `removable` are boolean attributes: an element cannot see whether a listener is attached, so upstream's "an `onClick` makes it a button, an `onRemove` adds a remove control" becomes an explicit opt-in. `click` is the native event and `tct-remove` the cancelable request to remove, carrying `value`; `href` adds `target` and `rel` with the same URL policy and router hand-off as `tct-link`.

The label control and the remove button are two separate tab stops, never nested (a button inside a link is invalid); the remove button's name is the localised "Remove {label}", `description` is the accessible description, and a disabled token cannot be pressed (the host ignores the pointer, so no `click` or `tct-remove` reaches a listener).

The Tecton chip roles (the neutral pill matches the badge, one size step up from a badge); hover and pressed states draw the edge in the token's own ink (half then full strength) instead of a wash, because a wash over the tinted fill failed contrast in dark mode. Every colour, form and state was checked in light and dark (tct-token.states.test.ts).
`teal` and `cyan` resolve to the same values in the Tecton palette, so they look identical; both names stay accepted.

requests.reason: The internal-link router hand-off (`linkContext.navigate` on an unmodified primary click) is duplicated in tct-link, tct-token and other link-like elements; a shared helper in core would remove the copies.

core.token.notes: Guides: [mwg:accessible-web-components] the remove button and label as separate controls; [mwg:styling-web-components] state styling through private custom properties; [mwg:custom-button-actions] press semantics of the label button. Size: 35 kB gzipped, dominated by the shared modules every icon-bearing element pulls in (tct-icon and the default icon registry, locale and context controllers); the budget is set above the measured size because the upstream complexity default (S) does not account for them.
